snippet.title: Choo Choo Survivor 2 Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Drive and survive through the zombie apocalypse and defeat the boss.  It is up to you to aim your weapons and upgrade strategically. Gather resources, rescue survivors and upgrade the might of your train through cool tech trees. Unlock new locomotives, weapons and bosses to defeat!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494210/Choo_Choo_Survivor_2
